name: Disrespectful Behavior
overview: Scripture calls believers to cultivate hearts strengthened by patience and courage as they wait on the Lord, guarding against philosophies and deceit that lead astray from Christ. Disrespectful behavior is countered by focusing on what is true, honest, just, pure, and lovely, fostering virtue and praise in thought and action. Moreover, living discreetly and obediently honors God's Word and prevents it from being blasphemed, reflecting a Christ-centered character that upholds respect in relationships and community.
